front: Stride at half Speed, trying to stay or become undetected, with a secret Stealth check at the end.
back:
Move up to half your Speed (or half another move Speed). At the end, GM rolls Stealth vs. Perception DC of creatures you were hidden/undetected from. +2 cover or +4 greater cover bonus if you had it throughout. You're automatically observed if you end with neither concealment nor cover.
Success: undetected.
Failure: hidden throughout.
Crit Failure: observed (hidden instead if invisible).
Observed as soon as you do other than Hide, Sneak, Step. Speaking makes you hidden.
